business_problem: Mercedes-Benz needed a secure, compliant internal generative AI tool that could simplify daily knowledge work, provide fast context-aware answers, and support cross-functional collaboration without exposing personal or sensitive data.
solution_summary: Mercedes-Benz Group built Mercedes-Benz Direct Chat as an internal web application for enterprise generative AI use. Employees submit prompts through the Direct Chat interface, which was originally based on OpenAI's ChatGPT technology and is integrated through Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service. This gives the company a managed environment for running LLM workloads with Azure security, privacy, and reliability controls. In 2025, Mercedes-Benz added Google Gemini so users can choose between multiple AI models, and it added DALL.E for image generation and image analysis inside the same experience. Mercedes-specific knowledge agents connect the chat experience to internal systems so the application can return tailored answers from company content and act as a central information platform. The solution is served in English and German, hosted in European data centers, processes employee prompts anonymously, and is governed by internal data protection policies and AI usage guidelines rather than storing sensitive data for model training.

solution_components.name: Mercedes-Benz Direct Chat
solution_components.role: The internal web application provides employees with a single chat interface for writing, summarization, image tasks, and access to company knowledge.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: It provides the core large language model capability that powers fast, context-aware text responses.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: It is the managed integration layer Mercedes-Benz uses to run the generative AI service with Azure security, privacy, and reliability controls.

solution_components.name: Google Gemini
solution_components.role: It adds an additional AI model option so employees can use multiple models depending on their needs.

solution_components.name: DALL.E
solution_components.role: It enables image generation and image analysis directly within the chat workflow.

solution_components.name: Mercedes-specific knowledge agents
solution_components.role: They pull tailored insights from internal systems and inject company-specific context into responses.

data_flow: Employees enter prompts in Mercedes-Benz Direct Chat, which routes requests through Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to ChatGPT or Gemini, with DALL.E handling image generation and analysis tasks. Mercedes-specific knowledge agents retrieve relevant context from internal systems and return tailored answers in the same chat interface. Inputs are processed anonymously, and operations are hosted in European data centers.
business_outcome: Direct Chat became an established internal AI platform across the organization, giving employees reliable support for writing emails and reports, summarizing documents, accessing internal knowledge, and collaborating across international teams in a secure and compliant environment.
metrics: More than 10,000 employees use Direct Chat daily as power users.
One concrete example is our AI Learning Journey, which tens of thousands of colleagues have already completed.
